messages.subject: Problem with Telemetry and Impervious Surface Covariate
parts:
Hi All,

I am in the last little bit of my project here and have been cruising but I hit a snag with using impervious raster as a covariate on D while incorporating telemetry. 

I successfully used D~ impervious surface on fDNA models only but once I added in my telemetry data to the ms.capthist, I am getting high densities, NAs on SE and CIs, and small sigma. It also outputs a ton of warnings. 

I'm not sure what is happening here. Maybe the covariate is not using telemetry to supplement sigma only. or the addCovariate could be reading in wrong even though it plots correctly. 

The end goal here is to use predictDsurface on the model output. Does anyone have experience using all these things together?

I am happy to provide code and files offline.

Thanks, Ashley
